negative_findings.description: Slovene-language queries aimed at media (Finance.si, Delo, Dnevnik, Svet kapitala) were answered almost entirely with bsi.si, uradni-list.si and pisrs.si results — the search backend is US-indexed and under-indexes sl media article pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: 3 of 4 sl seed queries returned zero media-domain results; official regulator/legal domains dominated.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Media coverage cannot be discovered reliably through this search path; article-level discovery for this cell must run through on-site search, RSS and sitemaps, or a sl-aware search index.

negative_findings.description: Direct fetches were refused for finance.si and dnevnik.si (tool-level refusal), sta.si returned HTTP 403, and svetkapitala.delo.si/finance/ 302-redirected to napaka.delo.si (an error page).
negative_findings.result_summary: 4 of 4 attempted media fetches failed; none confirmed dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These are hypotheses of bot defence and path change, not evidence of dead sources; the deterministic verification pass must retry with a browser-like agent before any of these is downgraded.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed URL was confirmed for any outlet in this cell, because every section fetch failed or was not attempted.

negative_findings.description: No established sl-language term was found for 'public consultation register' in the media context; media use descriptive phrasing ('javna razprava', 'usklajevanje', 'medresorsko usklajevanje') rather than a fixed label.
negative_findings.result_summary: Glossary term unresolved for consultation-tracking keyword filters.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Keyword monitoring for consultation controversies will need a broad phrase set rather than one canonical term, raising false-positive rates.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a legal/professional-commentary sub-cell covering law-firm newsletters and Slovenian legal-information services in sl.

coverage_gaps.description: The two highest-value outlets for this cell (Finance.si, STA) are both commercially gated; free tiers give headlines only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Budget for a Finance.si subscription and an STA content licence, or restrict collection to headline/metadata level and accept reduced depth.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe dLib.si and outlet archive pages for historical sl banking coverage and note licence terms.

brief: Slovenia's sl-language business/financial media layer is narrow and heavily gated: Finance.si (the sole business daily) and STA (the agency wire that most other outlets republish) are the two indispensable nodes, and both are paywalled or licence-bound, while Delo/Svet kapitala, Dnevnik and Večer add policy and political framing behind partial paywalls. Free-access coverage of regulation, supervision and payment-rule deadlines is realistically obtained from RTV Slovenija, Forbes Slovenija, Bloomberg Adria and regional portals that republish STA, with Necenzurirano.si as the outlet most likely to surface supervisory failures and de-risking stories that official channels omit. The trade-press core is Bančni vestnik (ZBS, since 1951, EconLit-indexed) plus the ZBS newsroom, which together reveal which draft rules the industry is contesting; banks' own 'aktualne objave' notices proved the most concrete open source for compliance dates. All four direct media fetches attempted here failed (tool refusal, HTTP 403, and a redirect to delo.si's error page) — these are bot-defence hypotheses, not dead sources, and require re-verification with a browser-like agent.
